_comment: Edits applied to machine-translated tests (scripts/py2ts_tests.py). Each entry is [find, replace, reason], or ["@skip", test name, reason] for a test of python-only behavior. Every skip is also listed in PARITY.md.
test/opc/package.test.ts: python returns a defaultdict(list); the port returns a plain mapping and callers default to []
test/util.test.ts: lengths are plain numbers (EMU) in pptx-ts, not Length instances
test/oxml/xmlchemy.test.ts: python metaclass; TS classes call defineChildren() instead
test/opc/serialized.test.ts: python context-manager protocol; the TS writer is closed by PackageWriter._write()
exercises python's zipfile.ZipFile; covered by test/opc/zip_writer.test.ts
python's zipfile.ZipFile; the TS writer uses fflate
test/api.test.ts: pptx-ts opens the bundled default template from memory (works in browsers, and templates/ is not in the npm package) rather than from its file path
test/parts/slide.test.ts: pptx.chart arrives in stage 5 (gljeremy/pptx-ts#5); the test only mocks this class (see test/stage5_standins.ts)
test/action.test.ts: TS has no keyword arguments: Hyperlink passes isExternal positionally, and this un-spec'd mock compares calls literally
test/shapes/placeholder.test.ts: pptx.chart arrives in stage 5 (gljeremy/pptx-ts#5); the test only mocks this class (see test/stage5_standins.ts)
TS has no keyword arguments; this un-spec'd mock compares the call literally
test/shapes/shapetree.test.ts: pptx.chart arrives in stage 5 (gljeremy/pptx-ts#5); the test only mocks this class (see test/stage5_standins.ts)
the TS module imports BytesIO from pptx-ts's fileio rather than using io.BytesIO; patch it there
pptx-ts bundles the OLE icons and opens them from memory (no template files at runtime); a user-supplied icon path still passes through
helpers for the icon fixup above
test/shapes/graphfrm.test.ts: pptx.chart arrives in stage 5 (gljeremy/pptx-ts#5); the test only mocks this class (see test/stage5_standins.ts)
test/shapes/autoshape.test.ts: JS has one number type, so 0.0 is the integer index 0; non-number indexes still raise TypeError
as above (0.0 is the integer index 0 in JS)
test/text/layout.test.ts: python's TextFitter is a tuple subclass built in __new__, so its mocked __init__ records no self; the TS class has a constructor, whose mock does
test/text/fonts.test.ts:

import { calcsize } from "../../src/text/struct.js";
